title: Host Cancellation Policy for homes
supports: Opened with WebFetch; effective 9 October 2023. Host cancellation fees by timing (50% within 48 hours or after check-in, 25% from 48 hours to 30 days, 10% over 30 days, minimum 50 US dollars); no payout for the cancelled stay; calendar blocking, possible suspension and loss of Superhost status; waivers for documented valid reasons.

title: Cancellation policies for your home
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Standard policies Flexible, Moderate, Limited (bookings on or after 1 October 2025), Firm, and invitation-only Strict and Super strict; non-refundable option; 24-hour free cancellation when booked at least 7 days ahead; long-term Firm and Strict policies for 28 nights or more.

title: Rebooking and refund policy for homes
supports: Opened with WebFetch; effective 6 February 2025. Covered issues (host cancels, no access, not habitable, significantly different from listing); guests report within 72 hours of discovery; host payout reduced by any refund; policy overrides the cancellation policy.

title: Host damage protection
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Document damage with photos and estimates; request reimbursement from the guest in the Resolution Centre within 14 days of checkout; guest has 24 hours to respond; exclusions include normal wear and tear and normal checkout cleaning.

title: Airbnb service fees
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Split fee (host usually 3%) being phased out; single host-only fee, most hosts 15.5% (others 14% to 16%), mandatory for most hosts including those using property management software; cannot switch back; no change dates given.

title: Areas where tax collection and remittance by Airbnb is available
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Airbnb collects and remits occupancy taxes, VAT or GST in listed countries and US states; hosts remain responsible for other taxes; accepting a booking waives a claimed exemption from a tax Airbnb collects.

title: Use Smart Pricing to automatically adjust your prices based on demand
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Host sets a minimum and maximum; custom prices per night; discounts can take the guest price below the minimum; weekly, monthly and trip-length discounts override Smart Pricing; Smart Pricing overrides rule-sets; changes don't affect existing reservations; may be paused in emergencies.

title: What's required to be a Superhost
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Overall rating 4.8 or higher; respond to 90% of new messages within 24 hours; cancellation rate under 1%; at least 10 reservations or 3 totalling 100 nights; assessed quarterly from 1 January, April, July and October over the past 12 months.

title: Restrictions on security cameras and other devices in homes
supports: Opened with WebFetch; rules in effect since 30 April 2024. Indoor cameras banned; outdoor cameras allowed if disclosed and not covering private areas; noise monitors disclosed and not in bedrooms, bathrooms or sleeping areas; how to disclose in the listing editor.

title: Authentic and trustworthy reviews (Reviews Policy)
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. No coordinating, incentivising, extorting or pressuring reviews; reviews can't be traded for refunds, discounts or reciprocal reviews; hosts may respond within policy; removable and non-removable reviews.

title: Responsible hosting in the United States
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Hosts check local permits, zoning, taxes, HOA, lease and landlord rules; working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms and a fire extinguisher; insurance not replaced by AirCover; neighbours and house rules.

title: Co-hosts: an introduction
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Co-hosts help manage listings and message guests; full access or limited access (calendar and messaging) set by a full-access co-host; host and co-host agree income split and expenses.

title: Customer Terms of Service
supports: Opened with WebFetch (first 100,000 characters); updated 25 August 2025, new version effective 10 December 2026. The property provides prices, availability and cancellation policies and must keep them accurate; damage policy gives the property 14 days to submit a damage payment request; sections A15.2 and A15.3 forbid automated or AI-powered assistants accessing the platform without written permission.

title: How We Work
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 31 May 2025. Reviews only from guests who booked and stayed or arrived, within three months of checkout, scored 1 to 10 with recent reviews weighted more, shown up to 36 months; properties may reply; default ranking factors include conversion, cancellations, reviews, price, and commission; commission paid after the stay.

title: Booking.com Connectivity Portal
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Properties connect through channel managers or property management systems; direct connections from individual properties not accepted; new connectivity provider integrations paused; APIs for rates and availability, content and promotions.

title: Commission acts to promote transparency in the short-term rental sector to the benefit of all players (IP/22/6493)
supports: Opened with WebFetch; the page renders by script, so the text was read through the Commission's press corner document service for the same reference. 7 November 2022 proposal: online host registration with a unique number, platforms help display it and run random checks, monthly automated data sharing through national single digital entry points, authorities may suspend numbers and require delisting.

title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1028 on data collection and sharing for short-term accommodation rental services: final act summary
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Host declarations (address, unit type, primary or secondary residence, maximum guests); registration number in a public registry; authorities can suspend numbers and order listings removed; platforms share activity data through a single digital entry point per Member State; in force 18 May 2024, applies from 20 May 2026. Used because Commission pages on the adopted Regulation could not be found or opened.

title: Short-Term Rental Registration Law
publisher: NYC Mayor's Office of Special Enforcement
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated (footer 2025). Local Law 18 adopted 9 January 2022; hosts register; platforms may not process transactions for unregistered rentals; enforcement on platform verification from 5 September 2023; prohibited buildings list.

title: What is Local Law 18?
publisher: NYC Mayor's Office of Special Enforcement
supports: Opened with WebFetch; undated. Stays under 30 days legal only with the host living in the unit, guests with full access, at most two guests (children under 4 not counted); registration limited to the permanent occupant; rent-regulated and NYCHA units ineligible.

title: Letting out a self-catering holiday home in England: rules and regulations
supports: Opened with WebFetch; published 25 March 2026, updated 2 October 2026. Fire, gas and electrical safety guidance; planning decided by the council; national registration scheme not yet in force, expected March 2027; Furnished Holiday Lettings tax regime abolished 6 April 2025; insurance; EPC; TV and music licences.

title: Apply for business rates for a self-catering property in England
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 29 September 2026. Available to let 140 nights and actually let 70 nights in 12 months, and intended to be available 140 nights in the next 12; private use and stays over 28 nights don't count towards the 70; new rule for owners of 5 or more lets from 24 July 2026.

title: Making your small paying guest accommodation safe from fire
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 20 January 2025. Guide for small B&Bs, guest houses and self-catering homes under the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, with a fire risk assessment checklist; larger premises use the sleeping accommodation guide.

title: Topic no. 415, Renting residential and vacation property
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 24 September 2026. A home used as a residence and rented fewer than 15 days: rental income not reported and expenses not deducted; residence test is personal use over the greater of 14 days or 10% of days rented at fair price; split expenses by days.

title: Rule on Unfair or Deceptive Fees: frequently asked questions
supports: Opened with WebFetch; guide dated May 2025, rule effective 12 May 2025. Short-term lodging including vacation rentals on platforms must show the total price including mandatory fees such as cleaning fees; taxes and government charges may be excluded but disclosed before payment; covers hosts and platforms that advertise lodging.

title: Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule: questions and answers
supports: Opened with WebFetch; Q&A dated November 2024, rule effective 21 October 2024. Bans fake reviews, incentives conditioned on sentiment, review suppression by threats; insiders must disclose; asking only happy customers not banned by the rule but may breach the FTC Act.

title: Fake reviews: short guide for businesses publishing consumer reviews
supports: Opened with WebFetch; published 4 April 2025. UK law bans fake reviews, concealed incentivised reviews (including a free stay) and false or misleading review information; businesses must not write or commission fake reviews.

title: PriceLabs pricing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Dynamic pricing with a 30-day free trial; market dashboards and portfolio analytics; Dynamic Pricing API; no MCP server mentioned.

title: Hospitable pricing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Free Essentials plan and paid Host, Professional and Mogul; 14-day trial; Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and Agoda sync; scheduled and automated guest messages; Hospitable Tasks and Cleaner Marketplace; API access and 'agents with MCP' listed on paid plans. MCP documentation page not found.

title: Guesty pricing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Lite (1 to 3 listings, 14-day trial), Pro and Enterprise; unified inbox, automated messages, cleaning and maintenance tasks after each checkout, Open API; no MCP server mentioned.

title: Breezeway pricing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Freemium plan free for the first property; cleaning schedules created automatically from check-ins, check-outs and reservation changes; checklists in a mobile app; maintenance work orders; 40+ PMS partners and iCal; no MCP server mentioned.
